name: CED Las Cruces
old_description: Since 1963, I-Line circuit breakers and panelboards have been the go-to choice for electrical contractors, estimators, and end-users, thanks to their unique design and reliability. Contact us today to explore the options available to you.
about:
CED Las Cruces operates in Las Cruces, New Mexico, as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network with more than 700 locations across the country. The branch has served the local community for over 50 years, backed by a sales team that collectively holds more than 125 years of experience in electrical distribution. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed on the company's website.

The location functions as an electrical supply distributor rather than a manufacturer. Its product offering is anchored by Schneider Electric and the Square D brand, covering residential, commercial, industrial, and solar electrical materials. In addition to stocking inventory, the branch provides switchgear quotations, project management, lighting quotations, lighting design packages, and a delivery service for customers in the region.

Primary customers include commercial electrical contractors, residential electrical contractors, multifamily construction contractors, and hybrid construction contractors. The branch supplies projects ranging from single-family homes to large-scale commercial and industrial installations, as well as solar energy systems.

The company states that its policy of service, integrity, and reliability drives its operations. It emphasizes representing top manufacturers and brands, maintaining a large inventory, offering quick response times, competitive pricing, and a dedicated team to differentiate itself in the market.
